# Fingerprinted assets behind one tag

**Rule:** Build assets with content-hashed file names and a manifest, render them through one template tag that resolves names from the manifest (or points at the dev server when a marker file written by it exists), and attach a per-request nonce and integrity hashes in that tag.

**Why:** A hashed name allows a long cache lifetime without stale files, and templates never branch on environment. A nonce generated by one layer and added by the tag cannot be forgotten on a single script. A missing manifest is an error, not a silent blank.

**Do:**
```
asset_tag(["app.js", "app.css"]):
  if file_exists(public/hot): emit dev_server_urls + hot_reload_client
  else: m = read(build/manifest); emit versioned_urls(m) + integrity(m) + nonce
middleware: asset.use_nonce(); header CSP = "script-src 'nonce-" + asset.nonce() + "'"
```

**Don't:** Hard-coding script paths, busting caches with query strings, or writing nonce attributes by hand per tag.

**Break it when:** No build step: plain static files need none of this.

**Source:** https://laravel.com/docs/vite ; code: src/Illuminate/Foundation/Vite.php
